extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: armored cash transport truck, approx. 6.1 x 2.4 x 2.9 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.92 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the rear door 'armored-truck_rear_door' is a separate object with its origin on the hinge (right rear edge, rotate around local Z to open); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), rear wheels are twin tyres; translucent windows with seats and steering wheel inside; no brand, no text, no weapons

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
